title: Rawhide braid
summary: Plait four flat strips of rawhide, light and dark, into a rein, taking the outer strip over one neighbour at a time.
howToPlay: Four strips hang below the braid.
The pair that crosses next is outlined: tap the strip that goes over.
Keep plaiting until the rein is done, then press Check.
rules: The outer strip goes over one strip, first from the right, then from the left.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Doing nothing scores nothing. Watch and learn plays a whole round for you.
heritageNote: Rawhide braiding is a craft of the gauchos of Argentina and neighbouring countries. Thin strips cut from a hide are plaited into ropes, reins and whips that are strong and supple.
